mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.0% per annum signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS declines below 4.0% over 6-month windows.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% per annum, signaling potential tightening, S&P 500 20-day returns turn negative due to higher borrowing costs compressing corporate profits.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS above 4.5% in >60% of instances over 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 demand exceeds 11000 and RSAFS demand surpasses 350000, indicating robust demand growth, S&P 500 20-day returns become positive due to market optimism.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 >11000 and RSAFS >350000 over 5-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low FEDFUNDS rates (<4.0%) and falling UNRATE (<4.5%) signal accommodative monetary policy and labor market strength, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS <4.0 and UNRATE <4.5 over 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the INDPRO supply index crosses above 112.1 (its current value), indicating robust production growth, S&P 500 20-day returns become positive due to stronger economic fundamentals.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite INDPRO above 112.1 in >60% of instances over 5-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 4.5% per month signals tight labor markets, boosting corporate profits and leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE <4.5 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime marked by CPIAUCSL > 110 and FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, accommodative monetary policy and high inflation expectations drive positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods meeting the regime conditions over 5-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rates fall below 4.0% and GDPC1 demand exceeds 11400 (current value), accommodative policy and strong demand drive positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both conditions hold over 3-year periods.
